snippet.title: CloverPit - Release Date Trailer - PS5/PS4, Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
The viral slot-machine CloverPit, a demonic lovechild of Balatro and Buckshot Roulette, coming to Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PS5 and PS4 on August 13th!

About CloverPit:
A rogue-lite slot machine nightmare. Gamble for your life in a never-ending debt simulator!

Nintendo eShop: https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-2-games/CloverPit-3152631.html

PlayStation Store: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017298/
